analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates a step-by-step blowout styling routine using the Wavytalk thermal brush with an AI voiceover.
analysis.full_description: A beauty creator with styled dark hair shows her final blowout result before breaking down a step-by-step tutorial on how to use the pink Wavytalk thermal ionic heated round brush. An AI TTS female voiceover narrates the process, detailing heat protectant prep, gliding through sections, curling ends in alternating directions for layered hair, styling the front money piece bangs, and showcasing the final voluminous result with a TikTok Shop call to action.

scenes.visual: Creator sitting in a bedroom holding the pink thermal brush in front of her face with bangs pulled down over her eyes.
scenes.action: She reveals her face and styled blowout hair by lowering the brush.

scenes.visual: Creator showing off her finished bouncy, voluminous blowout and smiling, holding the brush.
scenes.action: She poses and tilts the brush towards the camera displaying the digital temperature readout.

scenes.visual: Creator styling the lower section of her dark hair with the thermal round brush.
scenes.action: She glides the brush through the section and rotates it to wrap and curl the end, releasing a glossy curl.

scenes.visual: Creator demonstrating styling on a side section of hair with the top hair clipped up.
scenes.action: She brushes straight through from roots to mids once, then rolls the ends upward around the barrel.

scenes.visual: Creator curling another layer in the opposite direction.
scenes.action: She twists the brush outward to curl the ends out for multi-directional volume.

scenes.visual: Creator detangling front money piece with a paddle brush then wrapping it onto the thermal brush.
scenes.action: She rolls the thermal brush through her front bangs inwards and outwards to achieve crown volume.

scenes.visual: Creator shaking out her styled hair and running fingers through it.
scenes.action: She shows off the soft, bouncy, finished blowout curls framing her face.

scenes.visual: Creator smiling while holding the Wavytalk thermal brush next to her styled hair.
scenes.action: She gestures toward the camera and poses with the product.
